parameters.content:
## EP07 -- Inbox Router (drafts only)

Polls OUR OWN mailbox (IMAP, disabled here -- manual test only), routes deterministically (known-client allowlist, spam heuristics, regex intents) FIRST, and only sends the residue to one LLM node. Classifies lead | technical | spam | existing_client, drafts a reply, writes ONE Postgres row. There is no send node on this canvas -- see the other sticky.

GATE: ship only if rules handle >= 60% of mail (measured on the 12 samples + our own mailbox, see README).

## There is no send node -- why

Autosend was RULED NO (memory hq-followup-autosend-engine, 2026-09-21). WRITE WHITELIST GATE builds {kind:'label', name:'EP07/<classification>'} FROM CONSTANTS -- callers never supply a body -- so a mailbox LABEL is the only write this workflow can physically make. dry_run defaults true: no label is ever applied, the run summary just counts what WOULD be labelled.
